# Generated evidence: cctp/receive

Written by `pnpm report cctp/receive --record` from `templates/cctp/receive/template.json`, `templates/cctp/receive/docs.json`, `registry/contracts.json`, `testdata/report/cctp-receive.json`, `testdata/abi`, `testdata/research/cctp-receive.json`. The listings and pages were read on 2026-11-11. `pnpm test` computes it again from these files and fails on any difference: every section is recomputed from the recorded answers except the vault evidence, which is stored as `pnpm vault-evidence` printed it. The recordings were made on the AI's computer; `pnpm report cctp/receive --compare` reads the listings, pages, ABI proofs, code spans, ERC-7730 attestations and DefiLlama's protocol entries and hacks live, reads each vault again at the blocks its evidence names and each protocol fact and token's decimals at the block it was read at, fetches each recorded past transaction again by hash, and prints each fact that differs. It does not search for past transactions again, so it cannot show that a search found every one. Text from outside the program appears only as identifiers: a contract name Sourcify gives, printed only when it is a Solidity identifier, and the file paths, field paths and format names `pnpm erc7730` prints. The URLs come from the registry and `docs.json`, in RFC 3986 characters only. Text the AI wrote appears only where a row says it was written by the AI in the template. Do not edit this file.

## Calls and field rules

### Call 1 of 1

| Field | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | registry `cctp-message-transmitter` `0x0a992d191DEeC32aFe36203Ad87D7d289a738F81` |
| `value` | constant `0` |
| `receiveMessage` | calls `receiveMessage(bytes,bytes)`, selector `0x57ecfd28`; no bytes after the arguments |
| `receiveMessage.message` | free, claimed `proof`: every changed value must revert or be refused; written by the AI in the template: a packed CCTP message, which the engine cannot decode field by field; Circle's attesters sign it, so it cannot be changed without the attestation failing, and the effects require the Safe to get exactly the card amount of the card's token and nothing else, which fails for any other recipient or amount |
| `receiveMessage.attestation` | free, claimed `proof`: every changed value must revert or be refused; written by the AI in the template: Circle's attesters' signatures over the message: the transmitter reverts unless enough of them sign it |

## Official documentation

Each page comes from `docs.json`, whose contract must be the one the template calls the function on when the template binds it. The program compares the page's registrable domain, or GitHub organization, with the DefiLlama protocol of that contract, checks that a GitHub page is pinned to a commit on the default branch, and looks for the function's bare name as a whole word in the page as served, without scripts. A PASS there shows that the page names a function of that name, not that it documents this contract's function.

## Code pins

Every span of each entry's registry code pin, oldest first: a span holds from its block to the block before the next span's. A transaction to sign must run the last span's code, and an executed one the code of the span that holds its block. `pnpm pin-code` writes the spans from the chain, not from a review of that code. Chain: whether, through both providers, the code at the span's first block is its pin, and the code at the block before is the previous span's pin, or for the first span, no code `pnpm pin-code` can pin. A lone pin from block 0 was written before ranges and is not read.
